# Light and Shadows — sources

Rules: skill atlas-space-topic (references/writing-rules.md) and skill industrial-3d-showcase references/fact-discipline.md. Numbers in chapter bodies are `<Num s="S#">`; part details cite `[S#]`. Design values and the simulated operating point are their own entry (the design study), with the arithmetic in the notes; they are not measurements. Reference images used for modelling are listed in the content spec, not here (they are not published).

- [S1] Atlas design study for this topic (docs/35-light-and-shadows-content-spec.md §2–§4 and §9): a generic school light bench and a courtyard, not a specific product or school. DESIGN: classroom table 180 × 60 cm, top 75 cm high; aluminium track 150 cm, marked every 1 cm; the light's axis 30 cm above the table; LED torch drawn as a point of light at the centre of its lens, beam 40° each side of its axis; holder at the middle of the track; white screen 60 × 50 cm square to the track; cardboard shapes 2 mm thick: round card 8 cm across, square card 8 cm, equilateral triangle card 8 cm high, big round card 12 cm across; tin 6.6 cm across and 12 cm long and paper cone 8 cm across and 10 cm long, both lying on their sides across the track; ball 6.5 cm across; sheets 10 × 10 cm (glass 4 mm, cardboard 3 mm); three cards with holes 1.2 cm across, 10 cm apart, the middle one moved 2 cm to one side; torch 15, 20, 30, 40 or 60 cm in front of the object; screen 10, 20, 30 or 40 cm behind it; dark box 30 × 18 × 20 cm, black inside, viewing hole 1 cm; courtyard 11 m across with a pole 1.00 m high, 10 m from the bench. Model inputs: light transmission of clear glass 0.91 (S8), frosted glass 0.83 (S9), tracing paper 0.65 (S10), cardboard taken as 0. SIM: round card 8 cm, screen 30 cm behind: torch at 15 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 60 cm gives shadows 24 / 20 / 16 / 14 / 12 cm across; torch 20 cm in front: screen at 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 cm gives 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 cm. Torch 20 cm, screen 30 cm, height × width in cm, facing / turned 45° / edge-on: round card 20 × 20 circle, 20 × 15 oval, 20 × 1 thin strip; square card 20 × 20, 23 × 15, 25 × 1; triangle card 20 × 23, 22 × 17, 23 × 1; big round card 30 × 30, 31 × 23, 31 × 1; tin 17 × 36 rectangle, 21 × 33, 24 × 24 circle; cone 20 × 28 triangle, 25 × 24, 27 × 27 circle; ball 16 × 16 at every turn. Light sensor 10 cm behind the sheet, as a percentage of the empty holder: clear glass 91 %, frosted glass 45 %, tracing paper 35 %, cardboard 0 %; 30 cm behind: 91 / 18 / 14 / 0 %. Holes in line: a bright dot 2.0 cm across; middle card moved 2 cm: no dot. Sun for a pole 1.00 m high at 1.3° N, 103.8° E, UTC+8 (S12–S14), 20 October 2026: 8.00 am Sun 17° high, shadow 3.25 m pointing west; 9.00 am 32°, 1.62 m west; 10.00 am 46°, 0.96 m west; 11.00 am 60°, 0.57 m north-west; 12.00 pm 73°, 0.30 m north-west; 1.00 pm 78°, 0.21 m north; 2.00 pm 69°, 0.38 m north-east; 3.00 pm 56°, 0.69 m east; 4.00 pm 41°, 1.14 m east; 5.00 pm 27°, 1.99 m east; 6.00 pm 12°, 4.70 m east; Sun highest at about 12.50 pm (78.4°, shadow 0.21 m pointing north). 21 June 2026, 1.00 pm: 0.41 m pointing south (Sun highest at about 1.06 pm). 24 March 2026, 1.00 pm: 0.05 m / 30 / 40 厘米，影子 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 厘米。手电筒 20 厘米、屏幕 30 厘米，影子高 × 宽（厘米），正对 / 转 45° / 侧对：圆形卡片 20 × 20 圆形、20 × 15 椭圆形、20 × 1 细条；正方形卡片 20 × 20、23 × 15、25 × 1；三角形卡片 20 × 23、22 × 17、23 × 1；大圆卡片 30 × 30、31 × 米、西北；中午 12.00 73°、0.30 米、西北；下午 1.00 78°、0.21 米、北；下午 2.00 69°、0.38 米、东北；下午 3.00 56°、0.69 米、东；下午 4.00 41°、1.14 米、东；下午 5.00 27°、1.99 米、东；下午 6.00 12°、4.70 米、东；太阳最高约在下午 12.50（78.4°，影长 0.21 米，指向北）。2026 年 6 Shadow sizes are straight-line geometry from a point of light to the drawn objects; the model keeps the cards' 2 mm thickness, so its unrounded sizes are slightly larger than 8 × (a + b) ÷ a (by about 1 % with the torch 15 cm away, 0.5 % at 20 cm). Readings behind the frosted glass and tracing paper treat each sheet as spreading the light it lets through evenly in all directions (light on the screen = straight-through share + scattered share × r² ÷ (r² + b²) × ((a + b) ÷ a)², with r² = sheet area ÷ π, a the torch-to-sheet and b the sheet-to-screen distance): a deliberately simple picture, so these readings are illustrative, not predictions for a real classroom sheet. The transmission figures are published for particular products and one measured sample (S8–S10), not measured on this bench; cardboard's 0 is a choice for the model. The model gives the same number every time. Sun positions use NOAA's calculator method with its average refraction correction (S12); level ground, clear sky; shadow length = pole height ÷ tan(Sun's height). Clock times are rounded to the nearest minute. / 不是实测值。影子大小是从一个光点到所画物体的直线几何；模型保留了卡片 2 毫米的厚度，所以未取整的大小比 8 × (a + b) ÷ a 略大（手电筒在 15 厘米时约大 1%，20 厘米时约 0.5%）。磨砂玻璃和描图纸后面的读数，把每张材料片看成把透过的光向各个方向均匀散开（屏幕上的光 = 直透部分 + 散射部分 × r² ÷ (r² + b²) × ((a + b) ÷ a)²，r² = 材料片面积 ÷ π，a 是手电筒到材料片、b 是材料片到屏幕的距离）：这是故意简化的图像，所以这些读数只是示意，不是对真实教室里某张材料片的预测。透光率是几种产品公开的数据和一份样品的实测（S8–S10），不是在这张实验台上量的；硬纸板取 0 是模型的取值。模型每次给出同一个数。太阳位置按 NOAA 计算器的方法，含它的平均大气折射修正（S12）；地面水平、天空无云；影长 = 杆高 ÷ tan（太阳高度）。时刻取整到分钟。)
- [S2] Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division, Science Teaching & Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, Standard / Foundation (from the 2023 Primary Three cohort, updated January 2026). Printed p. 75, Energy Forms and Uses (Light): an object can be seen when it reflects light or when it is a source of light (the law of reflection is not required); light travels in straight lines, so a shadow forms when light is completely or partially blocked by an object; investigate the variables that affect shadows formed: shape, size and position of objects, and the distances between light source and object and between object and screen (the terms transparent, translucent and opaque are not required). Printed pp. 15–16: recognise a fair test (changed and unchanged variables); analyse data in tables and bar and line graphs to find patterns. Printed p. 40: the transparency of a material is whether it allows most, some or no light to pass through. / 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司《小学三至六年级科学教学大纲》（标准／基础，2023 年小三起实施，2026 年 1 月更新）。印刷页第 75 页“能量的形式与用途（光）”：物体反射光或自己是光源时，我们才看得见它（不要求反射定律）；光沿直线传播，所以物体完全或部分挡住光时就形成影子；探究影响影子的因素：物体的形状、大小、位置，光源到物体、物体到屏幕的距离（不要求透明、半透明、不透明这几个术语）。印刷页第 15–16 页：认出公平测试（改变的量与不变的量）；分析表格、条形图和折线图里的数据，找出规律。印刷页第 40 页：材料的“透明程度”指它让大部分、一部分还是完全不让光穿过。 (Read 2026-10-20 from the official PDF; printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page + 1).
